whoItsFor: Security researchers and developers who want to study how LLM multi-agent penetration-testing systems are built. The README limits use to code study and technical validation in isolated local environments, and prohibits testing online systems.
useCases: Studying an LLM multi-agent pentest architecture with dual exploration and asset graphs
Validating pentest workflow principles in an isolated local lab environment
Manually retesting previously reported vulnerabilities after fixes

requirements.runtime: PostgreSQL; Docker (Compose) or Go and Node.js to build from source
